title: Research: Signal Predictive Accuracy Audit v1
body:
## Problem and result
Audit unchanged sector_flag from PR11 frozen commit 5d5092b5d03e16f03241c1b5a5d5a19c1816c9c7 over 2021–2026-11-02. All 134 activation dates reproduce exactly. No trading simulation or signal optimization.

## Clarified sector-first results
Supplement: reports/signal-predictive-accuracy-audit-v1/specification-completion/ (Russian executive summary, all requested CSVs, source/parameter hashes, reproducible code).

Primary: next regular open, ten FULL sessions including reference session; down5 before up5. Incomplete/same-bar order UNRESOLVED.
- SOX:57 TP /76 FP /1 unresolved;42.86% precision.
- SOXX:56/77/1;42.11%.
- SMH:50/83/1;37.59%.
Stock and market results stay separate. Main annual table is SOX, not pooled stock accuracy.

Different target, any down5 touch over10: SOX46.62% vs40.09% nonwarning days, difference+6.53pp,95% block CI[-0.60,+14.93]. Quarter/known-regime matched difference+5.43pp,CI[-0.97,+13.24]. Incremental predictive advantage not established. Supplement intervals are exploratory pointwise499-rep60-calendar-session circular block bootstrap; parent1999-rep competing-barrier controls retained separately.

Pre-onset recall differs from pre-threshold recall: no warning within10sessions BEFORE onset in11/21 eligible SOX5% episodes,7/10 deeper10%,4/5 deeper15%. Both definitions inCSV. 47.4% mature SOX warnings already at least5% below prior20closinghigh. Of78 warnings between event peak and trough,38 occurred after half the eventual decline (retrospective label only).

## Evidence and limits
No confirmed original production payload obtained. Reconstructed saved sector transitions, saved Overlay/Forecast research snapshots, and unavailable production decisions distinguished; missing evidence is not HOLD. Price publication timestamps assumed, not proven historical vintage; dailyOHLC order ambiguity, split-consistent price-only/no dividend total return, survivor-selected universe, repeated use of history and overlapping windows disclosed. No investment-profitability conclusion.

## Validation and publication
43 tests passed,0failed,1environment anyio deprecation warning. All134activations and1465daily states match frozen source;6 new tests enforce full-window/UNKNOWN/onset boundaries.15 supplement artifacts reproduced byte-identically in fresh calculation passes before AND after publication. All18 local supplemental files match published Git blob SHAs;43tests rerun after publication passed again. Published full Git tree matches prepared tree8faec76dba80af3e5731bff89679dad545f2f607 exactly (all18 additions/updates, original files preserved).

Published commit:4f8e5615a1c4977b93558735da49c8b424de83ab.
Requested branch research/signal-predictive-accuracy-v1 and existing PR12 head research/signal-predictive-accuracy-audit-v1 point to the same commit. Existing PR source name retained because GitHub cannot change it; no duplicate PR, no force push. Initial supplemental protocol published first, subsequent files committed sequentially through Contents API after commit-object endpoint stalled. No production/trading-rule changes, orders, merge/deploy. Stop after audit.
